headline: European Central Bank holds interest rates steady as eurozone inflation moderates toward target
text: European Central Bank holds interest rates steady as eurozone inflation moderates toward target. Policymakers in Frankfurt signaled caution on economic growth while noting wage pressures are subsiding across major European manufacturing hubs.

headline: Quantum computing startup unveils 1,000-qubit fault-tolerant processor running error mitigation algorithms
text: Quantum computing startup unveils 1,000-qubit fault-tolerant processor running error mitigation algorithms. The novel silicon-spin quantum architecture demonstrated unprecedented coherence times, outperforming classical supercomputers on specific material simulation benchmarks.
